# Adopt C# example

C# SDK-style tree with a `greet` package and a stdlib-only `solo` package.

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init //csharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-csharp/...
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- generate //csharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-csharp/...
bazel build //csharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-csharp/...
bazel test //csharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-csharp/...
```

Both tests pass (`greet_test`, `pure_test`).
